source: 03_third_wave_README.md sections 8-9; registered before any W3 scoring
measure: Q01 primary mask, TRAIN cache seed 31 (RBF surfaces exist for seed 31 only), VALIDATION tie-break, S0, search seeds 31/73/101

fusion.eps_reference: blind TRAIN minimum of z_E = lowest selected E-component loss over its 3 search seeds on the same cache
fusion.sensitivity_fusions: F_0.5 with sd and q95-q05 normalisation
fusion.repaired_E: if W3-01 advances a repair candidate, the same fusion grid is repeated with E = that candidate on AD (registered as a new version before running)

selector.pool: finalists of E, X and the three F_w searches (TRAIN)
selector.score: max(z_E, z_X) on VALIDATION caches with TRAIN calibration
selector.abstain_flag: relative signed-permutation distance between E and X minimisers > .10 (reported, not used)
